 1. What type of cancer is small cell lung cancer? What is the
usual cause of this type of lung cancer?
Small cell lung cancer is a fast-growing type of lung cancer. 
It tends to spread much more quickly than non-small cell
lung cancer. Th ere are three diﬀ erent types of small cell
